text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-proxy-eu, severity=high — 5xx spike from 2026-03-15T10:00Z. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-91234 (auto details attached)

pagerduty: PagerDuty: auto-ack assigned to rotation `infra-eu` (escalation policy). Escalation chain: infra-eu -> platform-oncall -> eng-sre.

Priya Sharma: ack — I'm on it, grabbing context & joining bridge. pinging @Liam if infra side needed.

Liam O'Neill: oncall-ops here — I see the page routed to proxy stack and inference ingress. quick check: metrics show 502 rate jump ~10:00Z, spike mostly on /v1/generate proxy paths.

Priya Sharma: looks like errors correlate with a gateway timeout to `route-proxy-v2`. can someone post recent deploys?

Devon R.: FYI we rolled a small gateway config at 09:55Z (feature flag: new-routing-evict). I didn't expect it to hit production traffic pattern this fast.

Priya Sharma: ok mark that as potential cause. @Ava (support) please prepare a short customer-facing line: "Intermittent request failures affecting generation endpoints; investigating; mitigation in progress."

Ava (support): copying: short blurb ready. will hold until we confirm impact and ETA.

Liam O'Neill: quick debug info: `kubectl -n proxy get pods -l app=route-proxy-v2` shows 3/5 pods Ready on eu cluster. logs show repeated `upstream reset by peer` and `proxy read timeout`. snippet:```
2026-03-15T09:59:59Z route-proxy-v2-7f4cd: WARN upstream=127.0.0.1:8080 "HTTP/1.1 \"POST /v1/generate\" 502" upstream_err="upstream prematurely closed connection"
```

Priya Sharma: thx. Liam can you scale route-proxy to 6 replicas and bump timeouts to 90s for now (quick config override)? I'll trigger rollback of the gateway config if scaling doesn't help.

Liam O'Neill: scaling now: `kubectl -n proxy scale deploy/route-proxy-v2 --replicas=6` -> applied. Patching configmap to increase `proxy_read_timeout` to 90s, applying.

incident-bot: Action logged: scale + configpatch by Liam O'Neill at 2777778120. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

Priya Sharma: monitoring... grafana shows error rate starting to trend down from peak 18% -> 9% in last 30s. Keep scaling in place while we validate root cause.

Devon R.: opening an incident in tracker: https://incidents.example/INC-91234 — I'll add timeline and recent deploys (gateway config at 09:55Z).

Ava (support): draft message sent to customers: "We're investigating increased 502s for generation endpoints in EU. Our SREs have started mitigations; we'll update within 30 minutes." (will post once Priya confirms).

Priya Sharma: quick check on upstreams: `kubectl -n model-svc logs model-svc-3 -c grpc-proxy | tail -n 50` shows intermittent `EOF` and `deadline exceeded` around 09:59. Might be client-side (proxy) timing out. Rolling back gateway flag now as a precaution.

Liam O'Neill: rollback command queued: `kubectl -n config rollout restart cm/gateway-config && kubectl -n proxy rollout restart deploy/route-proxy-v2` — will watch.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ack by Priya Sharma at 2777778155. Escalation paused.

Priya Sharma: rollback confirmed applied at 2777778180. watching metrics.

Liam O'Neill: after rollback + scale: 502 rate down to 2.1% (from peak 18%). pod restarts stabilized. no further OOMs.

Priya Sharma: good. status for customers: reduced impact, mitigation in place. Ava please send update and note that root cause investigation (gateway config) is ongoing and may require a controlled config patch later.

Ava (support): sending update now.

Devon R.: adding postmortem template skeleton to INC-91234; assigning owners: Priya (incident lead), Liam (infra/root-cause), Devon (communications + timeline).

Priya Sharma: handoff note: I'll keep incident ownership for RCA and next steps; if escalation needed I'll reassign. leaving this thread for now but will post updates. Final check-in in 30m.

oncall-ops: acknowledged handoff. let us know if you want to rotate ownership to platform-oncall.

Priya Sharma: thanks — will update. current status: mitigation active, customer impact reduced, RCA underway. (thumbsup)

Liam O'Neill: leaving logs and commands used in INC-91234. will follow up with diff of gateway change that caused regression.

incident-bot: Note recorded: incident transitioned to "mitigated" state at 2777778400.

Priya Sharma: signing off thread for now — next update will be the RCA draft in the ticket.
